home.title: Research, Culture & Innovation
home.subtitle: MIRIT connects knowledge, cultures and technology to create meaningful experiences, research and practical digital solutions across borders.

gambiaProject.heroSubtitle: Building futures through education, one community at a time.
gambiaProject.missionText: In partnership with local educators, MIRIT is expanding access to quality schooling and vocational training for young people across The Gambia, creating pathways from classroom to career.
gambiaProject.storyText: What started as a single classroom initiative has grown into a network of community-driven learning centers, each shaped by the needs of the people it serves.
gambiaProject.ctaText: Whether through partnership, volunteering, or support, there are many ways to be part of this work.
